caption: Charles Moussette, [Spiral of Lightning in a Thunderstorm] (1886)
alt: An early photograph of lightning: a single jagged white bolt, coiled near its top, crossing an almost black night sky.
bibliography: Moussette, Charles. [Spiral of Lightning in a Thunderstorm]. 12 May 1886, albumen silver print from glass negative, The Metropolitan Museum of Art, New York, Gilman Collection, 2005.100.651.
